messages:
Marco Ruiz: Morning team! I'm Marco, starting on backend infra today 389 Remote in CET. Quick Qs: 1) VPN setup — any tips for Linux? 2) badge pickup when I'm in SF next week, who do I contact? 3) SSH access to infra repos, do we use company key manager or straight GitHub keys? Also hi everyone!

Theo (IT): Hey Marco 44b Welcome! For VPN on Linux we recommend the WireGuard client. Quick install steps:

```
sudo apt update && sudo apt install wireguard
# place config at /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf
sudo wg-quick up wg0
```

Send me your public key and I'll attach a profile. For SSH we use GitHub keys + internal approval UI (https://redwood.github.io/ssh-keys).

Marco Ruiz: Thanks, I'll try that. My public key is in DM. Also I use tiling WM so MDM on a Mac is annoying602 Is it okay if I keep a Linux devbox?

Nisha (People Ops): Yep, Linux devbox is fine if you prefer. For badge pick up, fill this form and choose "SF HQ pickup": https://redwood.intranet/forms/badge. Bring a photo ID and I'll approve the access. Also welcome lunch on Friday at 12:30pm if you can make it.

Priya Kaur: Hi Marco 60a I'm your buddy. I can pair with you tomorrow to get repo access and run through local infra dev flow. Also quick note: for infra work we recommend adding the company CA to your system trust so cert checks don't fail with internal services. Example for Ubuntu:

```
sudo cp redwood-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/
sudo update-ca-certificates
```
If you want a short screenshare at 11am CET tomorrow, LMK.

Marco Ruiz: Screenshare 11am CET works great. Appreciate the CA note 44d Also are there any team rituals I should know about? Standups? Weekly retro?

Priya Kaur: Daily standup at 9:30am PT (that's afternoon for you). Weekly infra sync Tuesdays, and we have a casual demos & pizza every other Thursday. Also sticker policy: we have a small stash of neural-net + cactus stickers 3384a1

Theo (IT): Added you to #eng-infra and #infra-oncall. BuddyBot will confirm channel joins.

BuddyBot: Marco Ruiz was added to #eng-infra and #infra-oncall. :tada:

Marco Ruiz: Awesome, thank you all! See you at 11am CET tomorrow.
